"Action bina motivation—bas baat."
Jo andar hai, uske saamne kuch nahi.
Soch jaisi, waise result.
Winners quit nahi karte, quitters win nahi.
Apne darr se mat dabo.
Motivation momentary hoti hai; discipline tikti hai.
"World ko jaisa hai, waise dekho."
Hum wohi hain jo sochte hain.
Bhavishya unka hai jo apne sapno ki khoobsurti par vishwas rakhte hain.
Failure feedback hai, defeat nahi.
"Himmat: jo darr lagta, wahi karna."
Abhi action lo.
